hotels.title: Boutique Design Escape in the Heart of Naples with Rooftop Bar Overlooking Mount Vesuvius
hotels.description: The soul-stirring beauty and elegant architecture of Naples are yours to explore from the stylish UNA Hotels Napoli. Housed in a restored historic building near the Porto neighbourhood, the hotel offers sweeping views over Italy’s oldest streets and frescoes, just a short walk from the city’s main attractions. Guests can enjoy authentic Italian hospitality at the rooftop Vesuvio Roof Bar & Restaurant, with home-cooked dishes, an extensive wine list and panoramic views of Mount Vesuvius. Nearby, explore Porta Nolana, Basilica della Santissima Annunziata Maggiore and Santa Maria Egiziaca a Forcella, or catch a train from Napoli Centrale to venture further afield.
